title: The Window
story_note: Two old men share a room in a home for the elderly. The one by the window describes a beautiful world outside to the one who cannot sit up. All characters and the home are fictional; no real person or organisation is depicted or voiced.
source_note: Adapted from a widely circulated parable usually called 'The Hospital Window' (author uncertain; often credited to Harry Buschman). The setting, characters and narration are this project's own.
audience: Young Ethiopian adults (the author's friends and cohort colleagues) who grew up around elders, watching on a phone.
intent: They feel how much a small, invented kindness can carry, and leave wanting to give someone hope.
narration_style: One warm, gentle narrator in Amharic, using respectful forms for the elders. Quoted speech is read by the narrator.

narration_voice.style_instruction: warm, gentle storytelling at a natural pace

visual_style: Naturalistic cinematic photography inside a modest home for the elderly in Addis Ababa: muted cream walls, soft green and warm wood, gentle window light. The imagined scenes outside the window are warmer and more luminous than the room, so the contrast with the white wall lands.
style_block: Naturalistic cinematic photograph, modest home for the elderly in Addis Ababa, muted cream, soft green and warm wood palette, gentle natural window light, shallow depth of field, restrained expressions, no text, no logos, no watermark.

characters.name: Ato Girma
characters.noun: elderly man with the short white beard
characters.description: Fictional Ethiopian man from the Amhara highlands, 78 years old, East African Habesha features, thin, deep brown skin, short white hair, short trimmed white beard, gentle smile with deep laugh lines.
characters.wardrobe: A white cotton gabi shawl over a faded light-blue pyjama shirt.

characters.name: Ato Kebede
characters.noun: bald elderly man with the grey moustache
characters.description: Fictional Ethiopian man from the Amhara highlands, 82 years old, East African Habesha features, broad build, deep brown skin, bald head, grey moustache, tired kind eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A grey knitted cardigan over a cream pyjama shirt.

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: Fictional Ethiopian woman, 27 years old, East African Habesha features, youthful face, deep brown skin, black hair braided back, calm kind expression.
characters.wardrobe: A plain light-green caregiver tunic with short sleeves.

music.caption: Sparse tender solo piano over a soft warm string pad, slow, intimate, bittersweet and hopeful, a gentle plucked lyre-like texture in the background, no lead melody competing with a voice, instrumental, no vocals.

music.mix_direction: Lower the music under narration; let it rise in the pauses and under the imagined garden; nearly silent on the white wall.

cues.direction: Piano enters softly and plainly; a quiet room.
Opens up and warms as the imagined garden appears.
Thins to a single held note; the empty bed.
Almost silent on the white wall.
The garden theme returns, gently, and resolves into the end card.

shots.reason: Establish the place, the two men and the one window everything turns on.

narration.text: በአንድ የአረጋውያን መጦሪያ ውስጥ ሁለት አዛውንቶች አንድ ክፍል ይጋሩ ነበር። ክፍሉ አንድ መስኮት ብቻ ነበረው።
narration.source_en: In a home for the elderly, two old men shared one room. The room had a single window.
narration.subtitle_en: In a home for the elderly, two old men shared one room. The room had a single window.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a small plain room in a home for the elderly: two metal-frame single beds side by side, one directly beneath the room's only window, soft daylight falling across it. Ato Girma sits propped up on pillows in the bed by the window, Ato Kebede lies flat in the other bed under a brown wool blanket. Cream walls, a small wooden table between the beds with two cups.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push in toward the two beds; curtain moves slightly in the breeze.

shots.reason: Show why Kebede depends on Girma: he can only see the ceiling. Girma is present only as his shawl by the window.

narration.text: የአቶ ግርማ አልጋ ከመስኮቱ አጠገብ ነበር። አቶ ከበደ ግን በጀርባቸው ተኝተው ጣሪያውን ብቻ ነበር የሚያዩት።
narration.source_en: Ato Girma’s bed was beside it. Ato Kebede lay flat on his back and saw only the ceiling.
narration.subtitle_en: Ato Girma’s bed was beside it. Ato Kebede lay flat on his back and saw only the ceiling.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium shot from beside the bed, slightly above: Ato Kebede lies flat on his back under a brown wool blanket, head on a white pillow, staring straight up at the ceiling with a tired expression. He is the only person in the picture. Behind him, out of focus, a bright window and the edge of the neighbouring bed with a folded white cotton shawl on it.
shots.motion_prompt: The old man blinks slowly, staring upward; the camera drifts gently sideways.

shots.reason: Introduce the daily ritual: Girma describing the world outside.

narration.text: ዘወትር ከሰዓት በኋላ አቶ ግርማ ቁጭ ብለው በመስኮቱ የሚታያቸውን ሁሉ ይተርኩላቸው ነበር።
narration.source_en: Every afternoon, Ato Girma sat up and described everything he could see through the window.
narration.subtitle_en: Every afternoon, Ato Girma sat up and described everything he could see through the window.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium close-up of Ato Girma sitting up in bed, his face turned toward the bright window so the light falls on it, one hand lifted slightly as if describing something, a gentle smile. Soft cream wall behind him.
shots.motion_prompt: The old man speaks softly and gestures gently with his raised hand, turning his face slightly toward the window light. Slow push in.

shots.reason: Let the audience see the world Girma describes, as vividly as Kebede imagines it.

narration.text: «በሚያማምሩ ዛፎች የተከበበ መናፈሻ ይታየኛል… ህጻናት ኳስ እያባረሩ ይጫወታሉ።»
narration.source_en: “I see a garden ringed with beautiful trees… children chasing a ball.”
narration.subtitle_en: “I see a garden ringed with beautiful trees… children chasing a ball.”

shots.keyframe_prompt: A beautiful public garden seen from slightly above: tall jacaranda trees in purple bloom around a green lawn, a small group of children running after a football, long golden afternoon light and soft shadows.
shots.motion_prompt: Children run across the lawn; leaves move in a light wind; slow drift to the right.
shots.style_block: Luminous warm cinematic photograph, golden afternoon light, rich greens and jacaranda purple, slightly dreamlike soft glow, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.reason: Widen the imagined world beyond the garden, so the later wall feels like a real loss.

narration.text: «ፍቅረኛሞች እጅ ለእጅ ተያይዘው ይዞራሉ… ከባሻገር ደግሞ ውብ ተራሮች ይታዩኛል።»
narration.source_en: “Sweethearts walk hand in hand… and beyond them, I see lovely hills.”
narration.subtitle_en: “Sweethearts walk hand in hand… and beyond them, I see lovely hills.”

shots.keyframe_prompt: A young Ethiopian couple seen from behind, walking hand in hand along a garden path under tall trees. Beyond the garden, the rooftops of a city and soft blue eucalyptus-covered hills in the distance under a warm evening sky.
shots.motion_prompt: The couple walk slowly away from the camera; the camera tilts up gently toward the hills.
shots.style_block: Luminous warm cinematic photograph, golden afternoon light, rich greens and jacaranda purple, slightly dreamlike soft glow, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.reason: Show what the stories give Kebede: he sees it all with his eyes closed.

narration.text: አቶ ከበደ ዓይናቸውን ጨፍነው ሁሉንም ያዩ ነበር። በዚህ ሁኔታ ሳምንታት አለፉ።
narration.source_en: Ato Kebede closed his eyes and saw it all. Weeks went by like this.
narration.subtitle_en: Ato Kebede closed his eyes and saw it all. Weeks went by like this.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up of Ato Kebede lying on his pillow with his eyes closed and a peaceful, contented smile, warm light from the window side touching his face.
shots.motion_prompt: The old man breathes slowly with his eyes closed and a faint smile. Almost still. Slow push in.

shots.reason: The loss: the bed by the window is empty.

narration.text: አንድ ማለዳ የአቶ ግርማ አልጋ ባዶ ነበር። ሌሊቱን አርፈው ነበር።
narration.source_en: One morning, Ato Girma’s bed was empty. He had passed away in the night.
narration.subtitle_en: One morning, Ato Girma’s bed was empty. He had passed away in the night.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Early morning in the same room, cool pale light: the bed beneath the window is empty and neatly made, a folded white cotton shawl resting on the pillow. Hana stands quietly beside it with her head bowed and her hands clasped.
shots.motion_prompt: Hana stands still, then lowers her head; dust drifts in the pale light; slow pull out.

shots.reason: Kebede's hope: at last he will see the garden for himself.

narration.text: አቶ ከበደ አልጋቸው ወደ መስኮቱ እንዲወሰድ ጠየቁ። ለማየት በጣም ቸኩለዋል።
narration.source_en: Ato Kebede asked for his bed to be moved to the window. He could not wait to see.
narration.subtitle_en: Ato Kebede asked for his bed to be moved to the window. He could not wait to see.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Ato Kebede, now in the bed beneath the window, pushes himself up on his elbows and leans toward the window with an eager, hopeful expression, bright daylight on his face.
shots.motion_prompt: Kebede strains upward and turns his head toward the window; slow push in.

shots.reason: The turn of the story: there was never anything to see.

narration.text: ከመስኮቱ ባሻገር ግን ነጭ ግድግዳ ብቻ ነበር።
narration.source_en: But beyond the window there was only a white wall.
narration.subtitle_en: But beyond the window there was only a white wall.

shots.keyframe_prompt: View straight out through an open window with a plain wooden frame: nothing but a blank white-painted concrete wall a few metres away, flat grey daylight, no trees, no sky, no people.
shots.motion_prompt: Completely still; a faint change of light on the wall.
shots.style_block: Naturalistic photograph, flat grey overcast light, desaturated, plain and empty, sharp focus, no text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.reason: The reveal, told gently by someone who knew Girma.

narration.text: ተንከባካቢዋም «አቶ ግርማ እኮ ማየት የማይችሉ ዓይነ ስውር ነበሩ» አለቻቸው።
narration.source_en: The caregiver told him, “Ato Girma could not see. He was blind.”
narration.subtitle_en: The caregiver told him, “Ato Girma could not see. He was blind.”

shots.keyframe_prompt: Ato Kebede sits up in the bed beneath the window, stunned, turning his face toward Hana, who stands beside the bed speaking gently with one hand resting on his shoulder.
shots.motion_prompt: Hana speaks softly; Kebede's expression changes from confusion to understanding; almost still.

shots.reason: The meaning: Girma invented a world to give his friend hope. End on gratitude, not despair.

narration.text: ለካስ ያን ሁሉ የሚፈጥሩት፣ ለጓደኛቸው የመኖር ተስፋ ለመስጠት ነበር።
narration.source_en: He had invented it all, to give his friend the hope to go on living.
narration.subtitle_en: He had invented it all, to give his friend the hope to go on living.

shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up of Ato Kebede beside the window with tears on his cheeks and a soft, grateful smile, his eyes lifted toward the window as warm golden light falls across his face.
shots.motion_prompt: A tear runs slowly down the old man's cheek as he smiles faintly; warm light grows on his face. Slow pull out.

production_notes: The film was first planned as 'Our Fridays'; the author changed the story on 25 November before any picture was generated. The earlier work is kept in outputs/archive/our_fridays and in runs.jsonl.
All times are planned. Real timing comes from the measured narration.
Characters, the home and its staff are fictional. No real organisation is named or shown.
Reference images for the three characters are approved before keyframes are trusted.
On-screen text (subtitles, end card) is drawn in the edit, never generated inside an image.
Portrait and landscape keyframes are generated separately, not cropped from each other.
